regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: DOS EXE header: 432 relocations, initial stack at 08AB:0080. Rebuilt by the museum unpacker after removing DIET.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 432 far addresses that DOS adjusts for the load segment, 4 bytes each.

regions.label: Borland C++ start-up (c0)
regions.note: Sets up segments and the stack, clears the zero-filled data, takes over the divide-error interrupt, calls main.

regions.label: Borland C++ runtime library
regions.note: C library code: bioskey, new and delete, fopen, fgetc, fputc, memmove, strlen and more (7,511 bytes).

regions.label: WINGRAPH.CPP
regions.note: His screen code: palette, title bar, menu bar, the File menu with its save-under, the status bar. 1,718 bytes from 159 source lines.

regions.label: EDITOR.CPP
regions.note: main: starts graphics, reads keys with bioskey and dispatches them through a 22-entry key table. 393 bytes from 119 lines.

regions.label: FUNCTION.CPP
regions.note: The editor: insert, Enter, Delete, Backspace, cursor, redraw, load, save and the file dialog. 4,598 bytes from 560 lines.

regions.label: Alignment padding
regions.note: Zero bytes the linker adds so the next segment starts on a 16-byte boundary.

regions.label: BGI graphics library
regions.note: Borland Graphics Interface: initgraph, bar, line, rectangle, outtextxy, getimage, putimage and more (15,472 bytes). The card driver loads from EGAVGA.BGI.

regions.label: Runtime data
regions.note: Borland copyright string and runtime variables.

regions.label: His strings and flags
regions.note: Menu items, status-bar help lines, TEST-EDITOR, INS ON/OFF, dialog texts; the insert flag (015Eh) and the line count (015Fh).

regions.label: Runtime and BGI data
regions.note: Stack limit, file table, graphics driver names and BGI error messages.

regions.label: Line table
regions.note: 601 far pointers, one per line of text. Zero in the file; filled while the editor runs.

regions.label: Cursor and screen variables
regions.note: Screen column (13DAh), row, column in the line, current line, line height 12 and character width 8.

regions.label: Runtime zero-filled data
regions.note: Work space for the runtime library, cleared at start-up.

routines.name: set_palette
routines.note: Reads the palette, then sets 5 entries: red, white, light gray, dark gray and blue.

lines.note: Color 12 becomes pure red (63,0,0): the cursor color

routines.name: draw_screen
routines.note: Clears the screen to white and draws the title bar, menu bar and status bar.

routines.name: file_menu
routines.note: The File drop-down: saves the screen behind it, lists 4 items and writes each help line in the status bar at y 462.

lines.note: outtextxy at y 462: the help line

routines.name: main
routines.note: Reads a key with bioskey(0), then jumps through a 22-entry table at 0262:0135.

routines.name: exit_editor
routines.note: Frees every line, closes graphics, then ends the program with INT 21h AH=4Ch.

routines.name: toggle_cursor
routines.note: Draws 3 thin rectangles in XOR mode with color 3; called again to erase.

routines.name: insert_char
routines.note: Opens a gap in the 204-byte line with memmove, then stores the character.

lines.note: Line full (204) in insert mode: ignore

routines.name: redraw_lines
routines.note: Clears a band of the text area and draws each line again with outtextxy.

routines.name: new_line
routines.note: Enter: moves the later line pointers down, makes a new 204-byte line and moves the text after the cursor into it.

lines.note: memmove: the text after the cursor moves to the new line

routines.name: load_file
routines.note: Reads the file a byte at a time; Tab becomes 6 spaces and long lines wrap at 201.

routines.name: save_file
routines.note: Asks for a name, opens it in text mode and writes every character with fputc.

routines.name: file_dialog
routines.note: Asks for a file name of up to 13 characters in a box that saves the screen behind it.

routines.name: delete_char
routines.note: Delete: at the end of a line it joins the next line; otherwise it shifts the rest of the line left.
